items.title: One in five London MGAs plan continental Europe expansion by 2027
items.summary: DA Strategy expects new MGA launches across continental Europe in 2027 following a poll of London market webinar attendees.

items.title: Three-quarters of UK homeowners uncertain about underinsurance, Paymentshield research shows
items.summary: Paymentshield survey data reveals widespread homeowner confidence contrasted with a lack of awareness regarding rebuild costs and policy limitations.

items.title: The Swedish Club applies 4% general increase for 2027/28 policy year
items.summary: The Swedish Club lowers its P&I and FD&D general increase to 4% as marine mutual insurers moderate renewal demands.

items.title: Geordie Shore star sentenced over illegal financial promotions
items.summary: Reality television personality Aaron Chalmers and finfluencer Jason Agbodza have been sentenced for promoting an unauthorised foreign exchange trading scheme.

items.title: Isio launches AI-powered employee benefits platform
items.summary: Isio has introduced an artificial intelligence-driven platform aimed at helping employers improve staff engagement with workplace benefits.

items.title: Quarter of assets on D2C platforms allocated to UK equities, Investment Association report shows
items.summary: The Investment Association has published its inaugural Investing in Britain report, revealing the allocation of retail investor assets on direct-to-consumer platforms.
